Plumbing follows the 2021 Uniform Plumbing Code, and Maine law makes the 2010 ADA Standards the accessibility standard for public and commercial buildings.
quote: MUBEC is adopted by the State of Maine and applies to all buildings constructed or renovated in Maine regardless of municipal population.
to_confirm: Whether the town enforces MUBEC (under 4,000 residents is optional). The main MUBEC page at maine.gov/dps/fmo/building-codes returned 'Access denied' on 2026-11-23; the building code division moved to the Maine Office of Community Affairs in September 2025 per a search result, so the authority name and URL may have changed. Because Maine excludes IBC Chapter 29, fixture counts come from the plumbing code.
